name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-05-16, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.79 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
